instrument: Development Agreement, Compass Datacenters PHX II (Aug 17, 2026, item 5.1.f)
summary: Council approved a development agreement with Compass Datacenters PHX II, 5-1, after pulling it from consent to the regular agenda. Reported terms: half-street improvements on Peoria Avenue once APS removes power poles, with certificates of occupancy allowed in the interim; Luke AFB review with site-specific stipulations.
text: Consideration and action to enter into a Development Agreement with Compass Datacenters PHX II in connection with the proposed multi-building facility located at the southwest corner of El Mirage Road and Peoria Avenue.

source.citation: City of El Mirage, Regular City Council Meeting Results, Aug 17, 2026

notes: Vote: Parsons/Winston, 5/1 (Nay: Gentry); six voting. Same night: council ordered 1,826 AF of CAP sub-contract water (6/0) and approved an unrelated warehouse CUP at 9105 N El Mirage Rd; no stated connection to Compass. Agreement terms are RELAYED from a Citizen Portal AI-generated meeting summary, which also reported no project-level water figure given at the hearing.
